FISTA_Nesterov.definition: y_k = x_k + beta_k (x_k-x_{k-1}); x_{k+1}=prox_{lambda/L}(y_k - grad f(y_k)/L); t_{k+1}=(1+sqrt(1+4t_k^2))/2; beta=(t_k-1)/t_{k+1}
FISTA_Nesterov.continuous_time_invariant: second-order inertial dynamics with vanishing damping proportional to 3/t; energy resembles objective gap plus kinetic/momentum term

Restarted_FISTA.definition: same proximal accelerated method with restart when objective increases or gradient-momentum inner product indicates bad momentum
Restarted_FISTA.linear_rate_condition: strong convexity or suitable error-bound/restricted strong convexity; here assessed empirically because p>n

ADMM_Lasso.definition: minimize loss(x)+lambda||z||_1 subject to x=z; x-update solves ridge least squares, z-update soft-thresholds, u-update accumulates primal residual
ADMM_Lasso.Lyapunov_diagnostics: objective, primal residual ||x-z||, dual residual rho||z_k-z_{k-1}||, and residual energy

VOS_unification.definition: Represent algorithms as discretizations of split smooth/nonsmooth operators: gradient flow plus proximal/shrinkage, with auxiliary momentum or multiplier variables.
VOS_unification.implemented_as: common Python interface and shared objective/prox operators; report derives unifying equations qualitatively and validates numerically
